features: Pentabrid video input: AHD, CVI, TVI, analog (CVBS) and IP cameras
Hardware compression: H.264 (feature list: optional H.265+)
Supported cameras: HD analog 1080P/960P/720P, IP 2.0MP/1.3MP/1.0MP, analog 1200H/960H
Pentabrid mode: 8CH = 4CH (AHD, CVI, TVI, CVBS) + 4CH IP
NVR mode: 8CH @ WD1 (960H) or 4CH @ Full HD (1080P) or 1CH Full HD + 8CH HD (720P); no single maximum IP channel count is stated
Per-HDD capacity: max. 6TB (optional 8TB per the feature list)
Email alerts on motion detection, video loss and video blind
